text:
anne.prodeng: Quick FYI 1 small billing change we're preparing: 1) set a minimum invoice amount of $2.00 to reduce noise from micro-invoices, 2) change monthly billing cutoff to UTC midnight (previously tenant local), and 3) make upgrades mid-cycle pro-rata on token/stream usage. Posting draft so product/eng/support can check for blockers.

billing-bot: [Draft saved] /internal/drafts/min-invoice-cutoff-pro-rata (preview)

lucas.billing: Short summary: - Minimum invoice threshold: invoices with total < $2.00 will be rolled into the following month instead of generating a separate invoice. This reduces micro-billing and disputes. - Billing cutoff: to simplify accounting across regions well define the billing day boundary as 00:00 UTC. Existing customers will see a one-time alignment window. - Pro-rata upgrades: when a customer upgrades a plan or purchases additional committed units mid-billing-cycle, well compute a pro-rata charge for the remainder of the cycle and include it as a separate line_item on the next invoice.

cfo.sara: Finance rationale: minimum invoice threshold cuts down credit card processing fees and dispute volume. Moving to UTC cutover simplifies multi-currency reconciliation. Pro-rata ensures revenue recognition matches usage windows. We ran models 1 minimal revenue impact and improved AR efficiency.

engops.zoe: Ops items: - We'll add invoice header `billing_cutoff=UTC` when exporting CSVs and a `pro_rata=true` flag for mid-cycle charges. - Migration: for the first 48 hours after launch some accounts may have an adjusted billing day while we align recurring renewals; exports may contain a `alignment_notice` header. Planned export migration window: 2026-09-12 01:00-01:30 UTC (expect short export delays).

support.ryan: Suggested canned reply for users seeing rolled amounts: "We now roll very small invoices (< $2) into the next billing period to reduce clutter and processing fees. Your charges will still appear on the consolidated invoice next month."

lucas.billing: Action items:
- Product: show the new billing cutoff in Billing > Settings and add a one-time notice in the billing UI for affected orgs.
- Eng: include `billing_cutoff` and `pro_rata` headers in CSV exports and SDK responses; add migration notes to devex.
- Support: update canned replies and the dispute playbook for pro-rata lines.
- Finance: update AR templates and tax rounding rules for pro-rata computations.

anne.prodeng: Tone guidance: externally say "small invoice consolidation" not "were withholding invoices". Legal reviewed the language; finance signed off pending a short FAQ on how pro-rata is calculated.

billing-bot: Example invoice snippet (preview):
```
schema_version=8
billing_cutoff=UTC
invoice_id,line_type,usage_units,unit_price,amount,region_code,pro_rata
inv_20261001,tokens,120000,0.0005,60.00,us-east,false
inv_20261001,pro_rata_addon,1,10.00,5.00,us-east,true
```

engops.zoe: One engineering note 1 downstream CSV consumers must tolerate the additional header lines. We'll publish parsing examples (python/js) and bump export schema to v8.

lucas.billing: Rollout timeline: internal notice today, help doc + FAQ 2026-09-05, UI banner for affected orgs 2026-09-07, new behavior live 2026-09-12. Please flag any blockers by EOD tomorrow.

anne.prodeng: Thanks all 1 I'll post the final announcement here once the help doc is live. :thumbsup:
